column1: # Real monitor profiles backed by decoded EDID samples from linuxhw/EDID.
# All 35 reviewed rows are FHD: columns native_x/native_y/refresh_hz describe
# the generated preferred timing and must remain exactly 1920|1080|60.  Lower
# compatibility modes may be advertised, but 1366x768, 2560x1440 and similar
# modes must never be entered here as a profile's preferred/native timing.
# Serial policy is derived from key: samsung-s24f350 uses H4ZMC + 5 decimal
# digits, redmi-rmmnt238nf uses 29200 + 8 decimal digits, and every other row
# uses the explicit generic-prefix-hash policy (12 characters total).
# Evidence-sample serials are reserved and must never be generated or accepted:
# source: Digital/Dell/DELF113/1875E76119BF (EDID name shortened to its model token)
